configuration: Release x64 localOnly; v143 / MSVC 14.44.35207; Runtime SDK Engine.lib SHA256 6846D88DEE3BAF892E3A4A06C1C965E7FC71966B78A1E5620972178FE7EE0C5D

entries.action: Created a fresh project through EngineLauncher --create-project, then enabled C++ through --enable-code with an isolated EngineStore.
entries.expected: A new project, source tree, locked SDK metadata and first private Game.dll build are produced.
entries.actual: Project created and template Game.dll activated; launcher operations exited 0.

entries.action: Restored ENGINE_GAME("ProjectGame"), wrote Content/ProjectGame.txt, rebuilt and launched through project.input.
entries.expected: ProjectGame, not the base Game, owns Play and calls its PreUpdate to create the corridor.
entries.actual: Generated GameTypeCatalog зарегистрировал ProjectGame; явный Content/ProjectGame.txt выбран. Настоящий project.input загрузил Floor, HallLight, CrateStop, SupplyCrate, три бойца, CorridorGuard, GuardVisual и TacticalHud.

entries.action: In project.input, Play + focus, held W for 180 frames, released W, then paused for 30 frames and resumed.
entries.expected: Selected soldier moves while W is held; when stopped by the gate, later paused frames preserve simulation state and Resume advances it.
entries.actual: Squad1 moved z=-6 to z=1.104 and stopped. During 30 paused frames Squad1 remained at z=1.104 and CorridorGuard remained at x=-0.819,z=1.817. After Resume the guard moved to x=-0.879,z=1.890.

entries.action: Started the real CorridorGuard AiCharacter with a MachineBuilder FSM; ran actual project.input frames and sampled game telemetry.
entries.expected: The guard follows Patrol/Pause tasks, transitions to Chase when perception sees the squad, moves toward the target and can intercept the blocked unit.
entries.actual: Telemetry recorded Patrol to Chase. In the blocked scenario the guard moved from z=6 to z=1.89, then the gameplay loss condition changed to lost=1 when it reached the soldier. This is game FSM behavior, not a hand-coded path replacement.

entries.action: Set the supply crate to an enabled Dynamic Box body, density 12, friction 0.55 and restitution 0.25; pressed E after ten warm-up frames to apply impulse (-150,3,0), then advanced 60 frames.
entries.expected: Real Jolt body responds to impulse and moves left at least 1.55 m, opening the corridor gate.
entries.actual: До Engine fix исходная настройка (density 12, импульс -150) дала x=0→-0.0209861 м. После обновления SDK тот же исходный impulse-request без изменений дал x=0→-2.22254 м за 60 кадров; gate открылся. В финальной игре физический стопор и restitution 0 удержали груз на x=-1.80638, затем наступила победа.

entries.action: Captured actual Game Play on the D3D viewport with project.input screenshots at 640x480 and 1000x720.
entries.expected: HUD, floor, dynamic crate, exit, player units and FSM guard are visible and remain legible across resize.
entries.actual: На реальном D3D кадре Play HUD, коридор и объекты видимы; 640×480 и 1000×720 после resize. Финальный кадр после победы показывает сцену и HUD «ПОБЕДА».

entries.action: Kept the scene JSON empty and generated this first gameplay map from ProjectGame bootstrap during Play.
entries.expected: The project opens to an empty edit scene; Play constructs its procedural corridor.
entries.actual: Сцена Main пустая, карта строится игровым bootstrap при Play. Edit visual и редактирование карты не проверялись.

entries.action: Rebuilt the private game module with the project Build.ps1 against the explicit pinned Runtime after gameplay code changes.
entries.expected: The new private Game.dll is validated and activated; failed source builds retain diagnostics.
entries.actual: Частный модуль пересобран явным pinned Runtime. Первый ошибочный C++ заголовок с буквальной \\n исправлен. Архив распакован в свежую папку, rebuild завершился сообщением Build validated and activated; DLL затем загрузилась в standalone и Editor Play.

entries.action: Один управляемый эпизод: открыть проход физическим импульсом, пройти к выходу и выиграть под давлением guard FSM.
entries.expected: Ящик удерживает проход открытым после толчка; боец пересекает z=9 до перехвата.
entries.actual: Груз стоит x=-1.80638; боец дошёл z=-6→9.312; guard Patrol→Chase; won=1, lost=0. D3D frame после победы показывает HUD ПОБЕДА.

entries.action: Распаковал source-only ZIP в чистый каталог, собрал на pinned Runtime и повторил победный сценарий.
entries.expected: В архиве нет SDK/бинарников; свежая сборка и игра работают.
entries.actual: ProjectTools подтвердил Build validated and activated; standalone Runtime прошёл 40 кадров (exit 0, custom Game telemetry), project.input повторил won=1/lost=0 и D3D кадр ПОБЕДА.
